**Manual computation:**

| # | Prime | Running Sum |
|---|-------|-------------|
| 1 | 2     | 2           |
| 2 | 3     | 5           |
| 3 | 5     | 10          |
| 4 | 7     | 17          |
| 5 | 11    | 28          |
| 6 | 13    | 41          |
| 7 | 17    | 58          |
| 8 | 19    | 77          |
| 9 | 23    | 100         |
|10 | 29    | 129         |

**Edge cases tested:**
- `isPrime(2)` → `true` (smallest prime, even prime)
- `isPrime(1)` → `false` (not prime by definition)
- `isPrime(0)` → `false`
- `isPrime(-5)` → `false` (negative numbers are not prime)
- The loop correctly stops after exactly 10 primes are found
